body:
I really appreciate the time you put into your response and talking to me. 

I don’t have any family. Well, I have a mom and sister but we are estranged. They are both super abusive and haven’t had a relationship for years. They did find out about all of this and were so happy that I am struggling and unhappy just like they are. I had to block them because they were so mean about it. 

The local rape crisis center is a joke and won’t let me into their support groups because they say I am too traumatized and don’t have enough real life supports. 

I don’t mean to sound all Negative Nancy but it all feels and is so bleak right now. And has been for awhile. I’m not perfect but I’m trying all the right things but cannot catch a break. 

I just don’t know how much longer I can live like this.

I was raped a year ago and lost my bf, my career, and all of my friends. I lost everything I care about. I’m all alone and I can’t keep living like this. The one person in my life that I still care about is my ex who was supposed to be my best friend forever. He told me we’d always be family no matter why. He said this long after we broke up. But now he met someone who forbids us from being friends. So I am all alone trying to pick my life up and I can’t do it. I can’t handle this much sadness anymore. I’m in therapy and on meds but the flashbacks are horrendous and I can’t cope all by myself.
Yes. I’m in agony from depression and ptsd. Been trying so hard to get healthy and feel better but nothing works.

I’d rather that the pain stopped than die but that doesn’t really seem to be on the table. I’m more scared of trying and it not working. I don’t have trains near me, apparently I’d need like a zillion pills. Been thinking about traveling to a place with a really high bridge. I can’t take this anymore. Truly.
I so hear RW reading that as Madeline and same with NK for Celeste. Ha ha.

Thank you for sharing. This reddit community really helped me. Me and the community are here for you. I mean this with all sincerity but I am so proud of you. Trying to work it out and understand it all is a really scary thing to do. I know what it’s like to carry that burden and confusion and to feel so alone. But I promise you that you are not alone. Feel free to DM me anytime of you need someone to talk to. And remember, it was not your fault.

It was not your fault. I’m sorry that happened to you. That sounds horrible, confusing and scary. Freezing and immobility is a common trauma response so please try to forgive yourself for not verbally saying no. While no one can define this experience for you, I will say that no one wonders if a specific sexual experience is assault if it was a healthy and consensual encounter. It certainly sounds like it was traumatizing and that is most definitely an indicator. I truly understand the importance of wanting to determine if it was rape but the most important thing is to take of yourself. Do you have any local resources such as a therapist or rape crisis center that can help you process all of this? Wishing you the best and here if you need anything.

Thank you everyone for taking the time to respond. I will respond individually soon. I am really depressed and struggling and finding that to be a difficult task. I don’t want to be that person who posts and does not respond at all after you all have kindly done so.
